headlines.title_en: Morgan Stanley's Xing Ziqiang: Two Trillion Yuan in Fiscal Reserves to Support Economy; AI Pause Doesn't Alter Long-Term Trend
headlines.summary_en: At the end of July 2026, the Politburo meeting set the tone for H2 economic work, outlining the overall macro-control approach. The NDRC subsequently followed up with relevant policies and special deployments. This policy round broadly continues the existing stock quality improvement and structural fine-tuning approach. Against this backdrop, market sentiment over policy implementation intensity continues to heat up. Regarding this policy cycle and H2 economic, industrial, and capital market trends, Morgan Stanley China Chief Economist Robin Xing offered a systematic assessment. He believes this policy round will not replicate the broad easing pace of 2024, and the domestic economy will continue to show typical K-shaped structural divergence. In his framework, the core driver for H2 stable growth comes from over 2 trillion yuan in fiscal headroom that can be deployed faster, with funds tilted toward new infrastructure and hardcore tech. On the industry front, the AI sector is entering a short-term valuation consolidation phase.

headlines.summary: 古巴电力联盟8月1日通报，当地时间18时7分，该国马坦萨斯省至比那尔德里奥省一带电力系统发生断电。古巴电力联盟在社交媒体上表示，断电是线路跳闸所致。受美国制裁影响，古巴长期以来难以进口燃料及发电厂设备，发电厂设备老旧难更新，全国电力供应紧张。2024年10月以来，因电力设施故障、飓风侵袭等原因，古巴曾多次全国大停电。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Power Outages Across Multiple Provinces in Cuba
headlines.summary_en: The Union Eléctrica de Cuba reported on August 1 that at 18:07 local time, a power system outage occurred in the area from Matanzas Province to Pinar del Río Province. The union said on social media that the outage was caused by a line trip. Due to U.S. sanctions, Cuba has long faced difficulty importing fuel and power plant equipment, with aging facilities hard to upgrade and tight national power supply. Since October 2024, Cuba has experienced multiple nationwide blackouts due to power facility failures and hurricane impacts. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Liu Yuhui: High Global Asset Volatility Far From Over; H2 AI Application Opportunities May Significantly Outweigh Upstream Hardware
headlines.summary_en: Recently, renowned economist Liu Yuhui stated at Bank of Ningbo's mid-year investment strategy meeting that in July, global assets experienced a steep bout of high volatility. This volatility was driven by three factors: geopolitics, the monetary-financial cycle, and AI's own industrial cycle. In his framework, the short-term focus is on the monetary-financial cycle - as long as the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield stays elevated at 4.7% and won't come down, the volatility is far from over. On the industrial dimension, he judged that U.S. AI is entering the mid-term test of three hurdles: the extreme imbalance between producer surplus and consumer surplus, the disruptive conflict between AI productivity and traditional production relations, and China's 'wall-breaking' capability from mega-engineering optimization. Liu Yuhui said computing power and tokens are rapidly becoming infrastructure, and 'those who strike gold in the AI industry will be the ones creating killer applications on top of dirt-cheap computing power.' headlines.title_en: US Plans 'Intense Bombing' This Weekend; Iran: Full Counterattack Plan Ready
headlines.summary_en: The U.S. State Department issued a broad security warning on August 1 to American citizens in the Middle East, advising them to consider leaving or be prepared to leave quickly. However, President Trump has not yet issued a final order for action. Iran's Foreign Ministry issued a statement the same day, emphasizing its determination to continue resistance. According to Iranian sources early on the 1st, a senior Iranian security official revealed that Tehran has formulated a comprehensive counterattack plan, with targets including Israel's critical infrastructure and U.S. energy facilities in the Middle East, ready to be activated at any time. (CCTV)

The draft requires better leveraging the role of housing provident funds, expanding the scope of withdrawals and uses, broadening system coverage, improving management service efficiency, and better meeting residents' diverse housing consumption needs.

headlines.title_en: Rubio: Cuba Using Militant Groups Against the US
headlines.summary_en: According to Fox News, U.S. Secretary of State Rubio cited a State Department report saying Cuba aims to use radical groups to counter the United States. ICE riots, pro-Hamas protests, and other radical movements are all part of a coordinated network that includes Cuba. Cuba's goal is to 'weaponize' these coordinated networks against the U.S. and to pressure 'U.S. policymakers' and global allies.

headlines.title_en: July Average Returns Negative Across All Private Fund Strategies; Quantitative Long Strategies Down Nearly 17%
headlines.summary_en: According to Shenzhen Business Daily, in July the A-share market saw notable adjustments, with average returns across all private fund strategies turning negative since July. Quantitative long strategies fell 16.94% on average, with only 4.03% posting positive returns - nearly a total wipeout. Subjective long strategies fell 7.91% on average, and though about 30% of products still recorded positive returns, overall NAVs still declined. In contrast, among managers with over 5 billion yuan in AUM that still posted positive average returns since July, core strategies were predominantly subjective long, bond, and managed futures - no quantitative long manager made the list. headlines.title: 美政府建议中东地区美国公民做好撤离准备
headlines.summary: 当地时间8月1日，美国国务院向身处中东地区的美国公民发出广泛安全警告，建议他们“考虑离开当地，或做好在局势升级时迅速撤离的准备”。据此前消息，美国官员透露，华盛顿正考虑最快于本周末对伊朗发动新一轮军事打击。与此同时，伊朗方面也称，将进一步打击那些允许美军驻扎军事基地的国家。美国国务院再次提醒，身处中东地区的人员应保持谨慎并提高警惕，同时做好应对航班取消、临时关闭领空以及其他旅行中断的准备。公告还强调，计划前往中东地区的美国公民应认真重新考虑自己的出行计划。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: US government advises American citizens in Middle East to prepare for evacuation
headlines.summary_en: On August 1 local time, the U.S. State Department issued a broad security warning to American citizens in the Middle East, advising them to 'consider leaving, or be prepared for rapid evacuation if the situation escalates.' According to earlier reports, U.S. officials revealed that Washington is considering launching a new round of military strikes on Iran as early as this weekend. Meanwhile, Iran has also said it will further strike countries that allow U.S. troops to be stationed on their military bases. The State Department again reminded people in the Middle East to remain cautious and vigilant, and to be prepared for flight cancellations, temporary airspace closures, and other travel disruptions. The notice also stressed that American citizens planning to travel to the Middle East should seriously reconsider their travel plans. (CCTV News)
